message.jaymoskingdoms.encounter.cyclops: A smell of woodsmoke and sheep on the wind, and footsteps that shake the scree. Something big keeps a fire up on the rocks.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.beast.cyclops: There's a giant with one eye %1$s blocks %2$s of here. Keeps sheep in a cave and a fire burning day and night.
Saw smoke going up off the rocks %1$s blocks %2$s. That's no shepherd's fire. That's the cyclops.
If you have to face the cyclops %1$s blocks %2$s, put an arrow in its eye. Blind, it can only follow your footsteps, so creep.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.170: A cyclops sleeps by its fire at night. Creep and it may not wake. Strike it while it sleeps, or put an arrow in its eye, and it goes blind for a while and hunts by sound.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.171: Satyrs dance round a fire at dusk while the eldest pipes. Bring them honey, berries or wine and they'll let you sit in, and a night by their fire heals you.
